lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Top plate (outer 1) to side wall A (outer 5), about 90 deg. In perpendicular sections at 25/50/75% the label point sits on the convex outer-skin apex: the nearest scan point is 0.21, 0.03 and 0.12 mm away. Along the whole 208.6 mm line, the highest point within 0.5 mm laterally is only 0.01-0.06 mm above the line along the bisector, so the line is parallel and on the apex everywhere. The scanned fold is about 210.2 mm long (s from -0.8 to 209.4), so the line covers about 99%. Both end close-ups show the line ending within 1 mm of the plate ends.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Top plate (outer 1) to side wall B (outer 4), about 90 deg. In sections at 25/50/75% the label point is on the outer apex, with the nearest point 0.09, 0.08 and 0.35 mm away. Along the line, the apex rises only 0.01-0.03 mm above it over the full 208.8 mm, so it is parallel. The scanned fold is about 210.1 mm long, giving about 99% coverage, and the ends are within 1 mm of the part ends in the close-ups.
